items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the tax law, in relation to granting a sales and compensating
use tax exemption for certain goods sold for the purpose of fundraising
organized by school-based volunteer organizations
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S698

SPONSOR: ORTT
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the tax law, in relation to granting a sales and compen-
sating use tax exemption for certain goods sold for the purpose of
fundraising organized by school-based volunteer organizations

 
PURPOSE:

Makes any item sold for the purpose of fundraising by school related
fundraising entities under $2 tax free.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Adds a new paragraph 45 to subdivision (1) of section 1115 of the tax
law to state that any item under $2 sold for the purpose of fundraising
sponsored or promoted by a PTA, or student organization, booster club,
or similar school based association which supports education or extra-
curricular activities for grades k-12 shall be tax free.

Section 2 is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

PTAs, drama clubs, sports teams, these are a few of the common entities
in schools that use fundraising as a tool to support their activities.
These groups are run by volunteers whether it be students, teachers or
in a few instances parents. Requiring them to collect and remit payment
for items under $2 is burdensome and unnecessary. Funds raised from
these events are a form of fundraising to support the group, not aimed
in making a profit. Removing this bureaucratic hurdle will go a long way
towards improving the outcomes these groups seek to achieve.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

S. 3199 of 2021/2022; Referred to Investigations and Government Oper-
ations

S. 315 of 2019/2020; Referred to Investigations and Government Oper-
ations

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect January 18th next succeeding.

summary: Grants a sales and compensating use tax exemption for goods under $2 sold for fundraising organized by school-based volunteer organizations.
